Import fixtures. Every text here is taken verbatim from a public-domain
source: Jane Austen, *Pride and Prejudice* (1813) and Franz Kafka, *Ein
Landarzt* (1919), as in `samples/` (sources in `samples/README.md`).

`docx/` holds the .docx manuscripts and the scripts that write them, each
with its golden `.json` beside it. `md/samples/` holds the goldens of the
two samples. More fixtures will follow, always from public-domain text.
